name: (02) Koldunic Sorcery (Way of Sorrow) — 1 Basic — The Insults of Krivda

system.description:
Krivda, goddess of hatred and bitterness, rides on the koldun's tongue as she delivers the most humiliating insult she can conceive, driving her target into a blind, attacking rage. Old koldun once carried Krivda's name into battle against Tremere rivals, preferring angry fangs to calculated Thaumaturgy. As with all Way of Sorrow powers, a botch turns the effect back upon the koldun as if the victim had scored five successes.

System: After spending a Willpower point, the koldun insults the target in the most offensive and humiliating way she can conceive (the insult must actually be roleplayed). The player rolls Manipulation + Koldunism (difficulty equal to the victim's Willpower). If successful, the target flies into an uncontrollable rage and assaults the koldun; if the target is a vampire, he must immediately roll to resist frenzy (difficulty 5, plus the number of successes scored against him).

MET System: Address the victim with an appropriately offensive curse as you spend a Willpower Trait and make a Social Challenge (Koldunism for retests) against the target's Willpower; you must roleplay the insult, or the power fails automatically. If you win, the target must make a physical attack against you on his next turn if at all possible. A vampiric target may instead attempt a Self-Control Virtue Test (difficulty four Traits) to resist; failure means he enters frenzy, which typically lasts at least five minutes.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
